LES BENNETT is still in Japanese hands. ARTHUR BEALES seems to have settled down to life in a prison camp and has "made himself at home"---if such a phrase applies!.

W.H.BOWERS was mined at sea: LES BENNETT (RAF) and CHARLIE STRANGE were also lost at sea. R.V.REYNOLDS was killed in Sicily and other promising lives lost in the Italian campaign;were KEN SHEAIL and LIONEL PENNY.

Knut Moe our Norwegian member, according to rumour from a neutral source, has escaped to England. Les Bennett is still amongst the missing in Malaya. His wife Olive writes ``It is over a year since I last heard from my husband.
